DeleteWorkspaceError.description: `DELETE /v1/workspaces/{id}`'s error: dropshot's error body, plus the dirty report when `error_code` is `dirty` (409).

dirty.description: What deleting would lose; set only with `error_code` `dirty`.

uncommitted.description: Changed, staged and untracked files, as `git status --porcelain` prints them.

unpushed_branches.description: Local branches with commits that are on no remote.

DirtyReport.description: The git repos under a workspace's dir that hold work not on any remote.

repos.description: Only the dirty repos; an empty list means deleting loses nothing git knows about.

GhLogin.description: Whether `gh auth token` gives the daemon a GitHub token.

oneOf.description: `gh` printed a token GitHub accepted, or one not yet tried.
No `gh`, `gh` not logged in, or GitHub rejected its token. The GUI shows a banner.

queued.description: True when it waits for the pane to be idle; false when it was typed.

oneOf.description: Once the pane is idle, done or blocked; at once if it already is.

Layout.description: A tab's split tree. Every pane appears once; [`Layout::split`] keeps it that way.

task_id.description: The task to leave it on.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to leave it on.

agent.description: Which agent: required for agent panes, absent for shells.

argv.description: The command. A shell pane without one runs `$SHELL`, else `/bin/sh`; an `other` agent pane needs one; `claude` and `codex` panes take none, since agentdeck builds theirs.

cwd.description: The absolute working directory, which must exist.

tab_id.description: The tab to add it to. The caller places it in the tab's layout.

task_id.description: A task to link. A `claude` or `codex` pane's launch prompt carries its title and body.

layout.description: The initial split tree, if any.

workspace_id.description: The workspace to link; the inbox when absent.

dir.description: An existing absolute directory to attach. Without it, agentdeck creates a scratch dir.

Note.description: A message left on a workspace or a task for agents.

read_at.description: When the note was delivered or marked read.

read_by_pane.description: The pane it was delivered to, if a pane read it.

task_id.description: The task it's on; exactly one of this and `workspace_id` is set.

workspace_id.description: The workspace it's on; exactly one of this and `task_id` is set.

read.description: `true` marks the note read now, `false` marks it unread.

read_by_pane.description: The pane that read it; recorded only with `read: true`.

Pane.description: A terminal in a tab, running an agent CLI or a shell.

argv.description: The command as first launched, launch prompt included. A resumed pane runs its agent's resume command, or a fresh shell, instead.

cwd.description: The working directory it was launched in.

exit_code.description: The exit code, once the process has exited.

session_id.description: The agent's session id: chosen at launch for `claude`, found after launch for `codex` (null until Codex has written its session file).

state.description: The agent state; a shell is `working` while it prints and `unknown` otherwise.

title.description: The title the program set, or empty.

text.description: Typed into the terminal as is; end it with `\r` to press Enter.

PrSyncProgress.description: How far a running PR sync is through its search.

pages.description: Search pages this sync expects, from the search's count.

pages_done.description: Search pages read and stored so far.

PrSyncStatus.description: `GET /v1/prs/status` and `POST /v1/prs/sync`: the `gh` login and the last sync.

last_error.description: Why the most recent sync failed; `None` when it succeeded or none has run.

last_synced_at.description: When the last successful sync finished; `None` until one has.

progress.description: How far the sync running now is; `None` while none runs.

PullRequest.description: The GitHub pull request behind a PR task, as PR sync last saw it (spec §8).

checks.description: The head commit's rolled-up checks; `None` when it has none.

head_ref.description: The branch the PR merges from.

number.description: The PR's number in that repo.

repo.description: `owner/name` of the repo the PR targets.

review.description: The review decision; `None` when the repo requires no review.

synced_at.description: When PR sync last saw the PR.

updated_at.description: When the PR last changed on GitHub.

Tab.description: A tab in a workspace, holding a split tree of panes.

layout.description: The split tree; `None` until the tab has a pane.

position.description: Sort key among the workspace's tabs.

Task.description: An item in the one global task list.

done_at.description: When the task last moved to done; `None` while it isn't done.

pr.description: The pull request behind a PR task; `None` for a plain task.

workspace_id.description: The linked workspace; `None` puts the task in the inbox.

Workspace.description: A free-form unit of work with its own directory.

archived_at.description: When the workspace was archived; archived workspaces keep their data.

dir.description: The absolute path of the workspace's directory.

dir_owned.description: True when agentdeck created `dir` as a scratch dir, so deleting the workspace removes it.

slug.description: Unique, derived from the name at creation; names a scratch dir.

name.description: A new display name. The slug and the dir stay as they are.
